header: Date Order with signature(s) of Judge(s)
Syed Ali Ahmed Zaidi, Additional Advocate General Sindh along with
SIPs Muhammad Amir & Sajid Awan of Police Station Kharadar.
Record shows that learned counsel for the petitioner did not furnish requisite
body: sets of copies and cost for issuance of notices to the respondents, therefore, office has listed instant matter for orders on account of non-prosecution. Today despite repeated calls none has appeared on behalf of the petitioner.

Learned Additional Advocate General Sindh files comments along with copy of Challan in respect of FIR No.173/2026 registered under Section 489-F PPC at Police Station Kharadar, Karachi which are taken on the record.

Since after submission of challan, remedy arises to file proper application before the trial court as is embodied under section 249-A or 265-K Cr.P.C. as the case may be hence at this juncture in view of the dicta laid down by Apex Court in case of Director General, Anti-Corruption Establishment, Lahore and others Vs. Muhammad Akram Khan and others {PLD 2013 SC 401}, this petition is not maintainable, which is disposed of accordingly.
Judge Head of Const. Benches Aamir/PS Judge
